left_out.why: The SHA-256 of its files (model.bin, config.json, tokenizer.json, vocabulary.txt) could not be confirmed from Hugging Face when the kit was built; nothing unpinned is ever downloaded.
Its licence and the SHA-256 of its files could not be confirmed from Hugging Face when the kit was built.
Its ONNX model and voices files could not be pinned (SHA-256 unconfirmed), and its runtime's phonemiser (phonemizer, espeak-ng) is GPL-3.0.
piper-tts 1.3 and later is GPL-3.0-or-later, and each voice's licence and SHA-256 must be checked one by one.
Its licence, files and model code (loaded with trust_remote_code) and its runtime (PyTorch, torchaudio, transformers) could not be pinned with confirmed SHA-256.
Its licence, files, description tokenizer and runtime (PyTorch, transformers, parler-tts) could not be pinned with confirmed SHA-256.
